purpose: attribute the d810da1 speedup to removing the shared acceptDone channel from worker select, and compare engines

load.source: other processes, mainly repeatedly restarted codebase-memory-mcp indexers using up to ~16 cores in bursts

experiment_a: go-worker only; trees run before, after, shared, shared, after, before twice; -count=5 per run, 20 samples per case
experiment_b: Noop, go-worker, 1 and 8 workers, -count=10, -cpuprofile; pprof top -cum text kept, binary profiles not kept
experiment_c: all engines at d810da1; 20 rounds of -count=1 so engines alternate each round
